posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral haunch and upper hind limb region.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the lateral face (sub-orbital and muzzle); white transverse banding on the distal segments of both thoracic and pelvic limbs.
